parsed.explanation: If outed, a visitor faces enforced criminalisation of gender nonconformity and same-sex conduct used as a police lever: Penal Code up to 20 years plus mandatory whipping, Sharia cross-dressing offences in all states up to 3 years, fines and caning. State targeting is documented, including 'full licence' enforcement, 122 officers hunting a trans woman, rehabilitation detention, and repeated venue raids culminating in the 2025 sauna raid arresting 208 men including 31 foreign nationals, with leaked identities, delayed release and embassy intervention. Custody means male-ward placement with reported sexual violence, humiliating searches and assaults by religious officials, repeated arrests, and 2019 killings with police mistreatment and impunity, with no anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse. Enforcement against tourists in private is uncommon, moderating frequency, but consequences and institutional hostility remain severe.
